WebSocket GUI state updates, slot tracking, metrics snapshots, and transaction waterfall handling.

# Purpose
This C file implements the main state manager for the GUI and WebSocket update path. It creates and initializes the `fd_gui_t` object, joins shared memory, and keeps a live summary of cluster state, slot state, leader schedule data, gossip peers, vote accounts, validator info, balances, startup progress, and block engine status. It also converts identity and vote keys to Base58, tracks tile counts from the topology, and sets the initial values for many counters, gauges, and history buffers used by the GUI.

The file also collects live metrics from the topology and publishes them to connected clients. Functions such as [`fd_gui_poll`](<#fd_gui_poll>), [`fd_gui_txn_waterfall_snap`](<#fd_gui_txn_waterfall_snap>), [`fd_gui_tile_stats_snap`](<#fd_gui_tile_stats_snap>), and [`fd_gui_run_boot_progress`](<#fd_gui_run_boot_progress>) sample metrics from tiles like `net`, `quic`, `verify`, `bank`, `pack`, `resolv`, and `dedup`, then update GUI summaries and broadcast formatted WebSocket messages. Other handlers process plugin events, tower updates, replay updates, shred events, slot lifecycle events, and JSON WebSocket requests for slot queries, rankings, shreds, and summary pings.
